source: NOAA WaveWatch III via Open-Meteo Marine API

quality.atmospheric_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API (temperature_2m, pressure_msl, 10 m wind)
quality.notes: NOAA NOMADS WW3 GRIB endpoints returned 403 from this environment and no GRIB2 decoder was installed. Open-Meteo serves the same NOAA WW3 fields as JSON, which we consume directly. The API requires equal-length lat/lon arrays; we fetch a 17x17 square over the display bbox and bilinearly interpolate to the 17x21 display grid. Atmospheric 10-m wind is pulled from api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast on the same grid+timeline.
quality.ofs_tidal_source: NOAA NOS Operational Forecast Systems via noaa-ofs-pds
quality.coops_tidal_fallback: CO-OPS harmonic station blend; estimated between stations; OFS frames take precedence
quality.co_tidal_source: awaiting NOAA STOFS regional HTP; station interpolation is not used

quality.grid_method: nearest wet ROMS rho cell; no extrapolation beyond 0.45 degrees
quality.notes: CBOFS/DBOFS zeta is total free-surface elevation and may include surge and river effects; depth-averaged ROMS u/v are included where available.

tide_harmonic_source.method: lazy regional mesh extraction + harmonic fit
